notes.title: Features explained: RAMMING!
notes.content:
[h1]RAM![/h1]
Ahhhh RAMMING, basically, you can hit other cars to inflict damage on them (this mechanic also applies if the enemies hits YOU).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/630853066ad6bfe362be12d961ccbb76b67dbb16.gif[/img]

Very fun stuff, usually, primary weapons overheat very rapidly to increase the use of this kind of mechanics and make the game a lot more fun!

[h1]BONUS![/h1]

Another level design!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/829ec9b3104ea0a4073753da13086993b6d49c16.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/8a8509aa684869a5647266674f88214094061cd9.png[/img][/url]
For this scenario, the player has a couple of options:
[list]
[*] If playing alone, they can use the Speed Boost to navigate through the fire blockers efficiently.
[*] If they have a convoy behind them, they will need to choose between two options:
[*] Turn off the fire blocking the path.
[*] Destroy the generator. However, be cautious, as the generator is protected by a swarm. Players can opt to take a secondary path to avoid the swarm.
[/list]
Enjoy the video! Speed is set at 12x when designing, but the level has been tested at normal speed.

[previewyoutube=bcpcS4sNhRA;full][/previewyoutube]

Follow us and Wishlist the game! 
Have fun!

notes.title: Features explained: Dynamic Zoom Camera
notes.content:
[h1]Dynamic Zoom Camera[/h1]

What does it look like, you ask?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/4c291e53ca843dad354d01508226207f9b1c63d4.gif[/img]
To put it in motion, simply unleash the mighty power of the mouse wheel!

And what's it good for, you wonder?
[list]
[*] It lets you peer ahead on the road, giving you a chance to brace yourself for what's coming.
[*] You can also examine your vehicles in all their glory, marvel at their awesomeness, and take in every detail.
[/list]

[h1]Bonus![/h1]
[h3]Level edition:[/h3]

What's happening here, you ask? This is a level of CANNIBAL difficulty, rated at 1.
Now, for your choices in this level: it's a rather simple one, with a couple of ways to go.

The path splits in two, and you face a decision. You can either douse the fire blocking your way or engage in a fight with a swarm of enemies if you have the resources for it.

After that, you face another choice. You can either quickly smash through the blockade to make your escape or take on a second hidden swarm waiting at the exit. But remember, going back might lead you into the clutches of the previous swarm. Choose wisely, for survival is never guaranteed in the Wasteland.

[previewyoutube=pauMX7VupsE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog 2: Enemy settlements mechanics for car games
notes.content:
Hi! I’m Hernán Smicht, game designer of Desert Pirates and I’m here to tell you about the elements we constructed for destroying enemy bases by shooting from a car.

We love to shoot at things, but we don’t want to shoot just cars, we want to destroy a lot of things, and when more interesting the better.

We construct the enemy bases around the resources buildings that  the player needs to destroy in order to get what he needs to survive and keep moving.

So, how to protect the enemy bases (besides enemy cars)?

First of all, we thought: TURRETS. Good. Turrets work, but they get old kinda fast, so how to improve them or give them some sort of strategy option to the player to get them down?


[h2]ENERGY GENERATORS[/h2]

Every turret or group of turrets are tied to an ENERGY GENERATOR, that is usually pretty well covered inside the bases, so if the player manage to get inside the bases (they should have a way) and destroy the generator he can get rid of the turrets for good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/a5fec3b6b00e64863d76a4e431d4320a350361e5.jpg[/img]

[h2]SWARM WORKSHOP[/h2]

When  the player get close to this buildings enemies cars start to abandon the building and attack the player, so the player has the option of dragging this cars for easy destruction far away from the workshop (avoiding the spawn of more enemy cars) or, if the player has a big enough convoy, attack directly the workshop before the enemies can spawn. 
By doing this they get the reward of all cars inside, and if the building are hit but not destroyed, spawned cars will get out already burning in flames!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/ee5b5bf11240a969d0db0c2713ec9c420e5a2f59.jpg[/img]

[h2]SHIELDS TOWER[/h2]
These are big  towers that can protect anything inside their shield cover, we can put generators or resources (avoiding the hit and run over resource buildings, that is fun, but this mechanic adds another pace to the game). So the player first has to take down the shield in order to destroy whatever it protects. Once the shield is down the player  can choose to destroy the shield tower before the shield reestablishes, or destroy what is protecting, with the chance to get trapped (he or other from his convoy) inside the shield, becoming an easy target to enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/af129b853c143c4352a8731c276b689ef76ddadf.jpg[/img]

[h2]FUEL BARRELS[/h2], a classic!
They work as an exploding timer, or if you shoot a couple of bullets more they explode immediately. They damage enemies and friends, so there is risk for both sides.
If being in pursuit the player can ignite a barrel with one shot and drag an enemy to get splashed by its explosion. Also, if sided to a turret, they interrupt the function of turrets and give him some time to take it down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39001909/013accc5961fe9e063ea59f46cd59d8e32634017.jpg[/img]

That’s it! Those are the base mechanics beside cars we have implemented until now, got more ideas? Don't hesitate to share! Questions? Shoot away!

Wishlist us!!

See you!
